blocks.html:
Vent connectors for medium-heat appliances shall be constructed of factory-built medium-heat chimney sections or steel of a thickness not less than that specified in Table 503.10.2.5 and shall comply with the following:
   1.   A steel vent connector for an appliance with a vent gas temperature in excess of 1,000°F (537.8°C) measured at the entrance to the connector shall be lined with medium-duty fire brick (ASTM C 64, Type F), or the equivalent.
   2.   The lining shall be not less than 2 1/2 inches (63.5 mm) thick for a vent connector having a diameter or greatest cross-sectional dimension of 18 inches (457.2 mm) or less.
   3.   The lining shall be not less than 4 1/2 inches (114.3 mm) thick laid on the 4 1/2-inch (114.3 mm) bed for a vent connector having a diameter or greatest cross-sectional dimension greater than 18 inches (457.2 mm).
   4.   Factory-built chimney sections, if employed, shall be joined together in accordance with the chimney manufacturers' instructions.

Minimum Thickness for Steel Vent Connectors for Medium-Heat Appliances
